 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Crlmc No.45 of 2024
 Susansu Mishra Petitioner(s)
 Mr. S.K. Swain, Adv.
 -versus-

 Justice S.S. Mishra
 Order

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner has assailed the order dated 02.01.2024 passed by the learned J.M.F.C. (Cog.I) Bhubaneswar in connection with C.T. Case No.426 of 2023 corresponding to Lingaraj P.S. Case No.166 dated 03.06.2023 for the offences under Sections 420/294 IPC whereby the learned court below has issued NBW against the petitioner for having failed to comply with the condition of the bail.
2. On 19.10.2023 vide BLAPL No.10038 of 2023, the coordinate Bench of this court enlarge the petitioner on bail on certain conditions.
3. The petitioner undertakes to comply with the conditions // 2 // imposed by the court granting bail and appear before the court below as and when directed.

4. The order dated 02.01.2024 passed by the Learned J.M.F.C. (Cog.I) Bhubaneswar in connection with C.T. Case No.426 of 2023 corresponding to Lingaraj P.S. Case No.166 dated 03.06.2023 for the offences under Sections 420/294 IPC is set aside to the extent of issuing NBW against the petitioner subject to the petitioner depositing of Rs.1000/- (Rupees one thousand) to the Orissa High Court Advocates' Welfare Fund.

entities.text: Orissa High Court Advocates' Welfare Fund
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. The CRLMC is accordingly disposed of.
